next: Root reviews actual MH0/NI1 pilot before deciding segment 1; each later segment requires review of all already returned paired results.
scope: Fixed original eight development cases only; no held-out/general/batch quality claim. This inventory authorizes no launch.

initial_pilot.execution_status: Root-owned existing run; this manifest does not assert its completion or outcome.

budget_scope: Upper limits, not executed cost. Preserve entered/returned/failed counts, elapsed time and memory for every dispatched segment, including stopped/failed work. Initialization is separate from score/DT counts.
method_invariance: Same frozen native, precision, finite operators, source weights and scorer. No selection/weight/layer/rule adjustment after partial results. Factory/runtime defaults are not changed.

evaluation.original_curves: Every method gets all original 21 native scorer points on its own fresh attribution order, using the unchanged original metric function; record needle where defined, RISE and both MAS returns.
evaluation.paired_reporting: Report every case and both directions of change, all completed paired values, and descriptive paired means over exactly the completed set with its fixed-set denominator. Do not choose report membership from improvements. RISE/MAS lower is better. MH has no NIAH needle gold.
evaluation.fixed_control_mask_error: Use that segment new control attribution order and original 20 bins. Contract both new signed vectors on each identical control deletion set against the actual new control score curve, retaining raw signed response, signed densities and un-clipped conditional errors. No extra scorer calls and no claim that this ledger is a second MAS curve.
evaluation.receipts: Preserve all original own-curve score/input/deletion-set receipts, clean/allEOS endpoints, fixed control masks, complete/evaluated vectors and source-input/vector/endpoint drift against the earlier eight-case artifacts. BF16 cross-process drift is neither assumed to be zero nor automatically an error.

continuation.rule: A material paired regression in any partial result stops later segments. Root records the observed regression and decision; remaining fixed cases stay incomplete.
continuation.threshold: No newly invented numerical tolerance, significance cutoff, aggregate compensation rule or automatic pass threshold.
continuation.prohibited: Do not switch cases, selected layer, PV weights or method after seeing improvement; no reruns to select a favorable trace; no eight-case pass claim when any segment remains incomplete.

historical_FT.source: Original completed eight-case same-input FT0/FT3 measurements, referenced by immutable results and receipt hashes below. No new FT trace or scorer calls.
historical_FT.limitation: Historical comparisons are not same-process matched new FT measurements. Preserve actual new and historical clean/allEOS scores and native cross-process drift; identical raw input/source does not make attribution seeds or observed score endpoints identical.

provenance.published_difference_only: optional_tokenizer_preflight.file replaced /tmp with ${ARTIFACT_ROOT}; all other parsed fields equal. Four original run copies are byte-identical to canonical audit manifest.
